'''Saell-Terae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] who claimed to be a dealer in antiquities. The owner of the ship ''[[Lost Reef]]'', he spent a time mapping the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for unclear reasons. After a brush with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], Saell-Terae was forced to abandon his ship, at least temporarily.

==Biography==
Saell-Terae, a self-proclaimed dealer in antiques, purched the submersible [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]'', built by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] shipwrights, in an auction to private owners. He apparently wanted to use the ship for the purpose of mapping areas of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], although he had no short-term monetary goals in this venture.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

To do so, Saell-Terae performed several customizations on the ship, including replacing the Calamari life-support system with a different model designed for non-amphibious. He also replaced the shielding package with a better one, added new targeting computers and outfitted the ship with powerful, hidden weapons that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would deem illegal.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

While in the Unknown Regions, Saell-Terae acquired a [[Three warrior statues|trio of gem-incrusted statues]] crafted by a [[Unidentified military commander|warlord]] from a local, [[Unidentified species (Unknown Regions)|primitive species]]. At that point, this species was in conflict with art connoisseur [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Thrawn, who wanted to study the species' artworks to understand his enemy, offered to buy the statues from Saell-Terae, but the Yarkora refused for unknown reasons. Thrawn disliked this answer and Saell-Terae was forced to escape from [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial forces]], including the ''[[Admonitor]]''.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Eventually going into hiding from the Empire, Saell-Terae deleted the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] of the ''[[Lost Reef]]'' and abandoned the ship near [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in order to evade Thrawn's agents. He nonetheless left the statues on the pontoon of the ship, and forgot a hidden [[Dataplaque/Legends|dataplaque]] with detailed astrogation charts in the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. The ship then appeared mysteriously alone.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Personality and traits==
Saell-Terae kept his real goals a secret, but he was known to not get any profit at all in any negotiation he made.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Saell-Terae liked his ship. Once he was forced to abandon it, he assumed a new crew would claim it. Saell-Terae would then try to recover the ''Lost Reef'', and was ready to kill the new owners if needed.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
